Institutional Squeeze Scanner

Scans the full NSE universe every trading day. Finds stocks where EMA 20/50 are compressed (≤ 1.5%), volume is strictly below the 20-day SMA (exhaustion), and RSI is in the 30–55 neutral zone. RSI ≥ 65 is disqualified. Mentor's 7 seed stocks are always included. Each card includes 36-month back-test metrics.

Scan: 26 Sep 2026, 12:02 AM IST Universe: 501 stocks analysed 111 Critical 12 Setup 60 Watch 7 seed | 494 universe finds BRD: EMA ≤1.5% | Vol < SMA(20) | RSI 30–55 | Disqualify ≥65

🎯 Critical

All 3 BRD conditions: EMA ≤1.5% + Vol < SMA(20) + RSI 30–55.

⚡ Setup

EMA compressed + volume exhaustion. RSI still outside zone.

🔄 Watch

EMAs compressing. Awaiting volume dry-up confirmation.

🚫 Overextended

RSI ≥ 65 — retail FOMO. BRD disqualifies this entry.

Framework A — High-Velocity Swing Breakout

Price above EMA-50. Horizon: 5–15 sessions. Entry: Day 1 above resistance box + VWAP. SL: daily close below breakout candle's wick.

Framework B — Positional Bottom-Sweep

Price below EMA-50. Horizon: 3–24 months. Entry: 3-tier grid below price anchored to 50-week EMA/structural floors. SL optional if asset is debt-free.

Mentor's Framework

Why no hard stop-loss?

Cash equity only — no leverage, no F&O. Fundamentally strong businesses. A 5% global shock is temporary noise; the business value doesn't change overnight.

The positional safety net

If a swing trade hits volatility, it converts to a short-term positional hold (1–3 weeks). Strong fundamentals + historical support absorb the drawdown naturally.
